description: "When disaster strikes, the Rescue Team sweeps in to save the day!  Take control of workers who respond when a devastating tornado leaves its mark on three all-new islands in this exhilarating time management adventure.  Overcome earthquakes, rebuild hospitals and drill for oil to keep your vehicles running.  Use strategy to figure out the quickest way to complete your goals, and then race against the clock to remove debris, repair bridges, put out fires, restore communications and save victims.
